newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy quarterly budget data due March 20-25 - source.
newsitem.headline: Italy quarterly budget data due March 20-25 - source.

text.p: Italian quarterly accounts, which will be used to decide the size of the forthcoming mini-budget, will be ready sometime between March 20 to March 25, a ministerial source told Reuters.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has said the budget will include some 14 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures.
The package is due to be unveiled before local elections on April 27. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
